_templates_note: template paths below resolve relative to this policy file's directory (llm-error-feedback.mjs falls back to dirname(--policy)) — keeps the same file usable from both repo layouts (agent/config/ in the core, scripts/ in the public repo)

catalog.200: Success - returns the model list / normal response
catalog.400: Bad request - invalid parameters or malformed request body
catalog.403: Forbidden - no permission, insufficient quota, or account banned
catalog.429: Too many requests - rate limit exceeded
catalog.520/522/524: Cloudflare gateway errors (measured on b.ai free tier: ~100s kill switch on slow prefill, origin timeouts)
catalog.connection: Remote end closed / connection reset without an HTTP status

rules.note: Prepare-stage prerequisite failure (no resolvable/valid semver version): a deterministic property of the submitted snapshot — retrying it is pointless. Synthetic sentinels from the gate job name this rule directly; the match clause is deliberately narrow so runtime LLM errors never classify here.
Deterministic pre-dispatch rejection (measured ~0.5s); retrying is pointless. Submission-side problem.
Harness failed to clamp max_tokens to the endpoint's max_output_tokens. Operations-side bug, alert a human.
Provider balance exhausted; issue stays open so the audit can be re-run after top-up. Keeps the Ko-fi message.
b.ai free tier measured ~10 req/min per account/IP, empty body, no Retry-After header.
The dominant real failure on the free tier: Cloudflare kills slow prefill at ~100s and origins time out. compaction.trigger_tokens keeps single requests away from the kill line.

match.message_regex: Remote end closed|connection reset|ECONNRESET|socket hang up

rules.note: Status-less kill: the gateway closes the connection mid-prefill (measured on the free tier at 96K tokens / 76s). No HTTP status to match on.
